$comment: What walk.mjs visits and what it expects on each surface. Later waves EXTEND this file rather than the script.
Text matching is case-insensitive with whitespace collapsed, over the page's rendered text (innerText) plus its title.

Placeholders: $villageName, $restorativeStep, $careRoleName, $careHolderName, $canvasReading, $seasonName, $seasonWeekTitle come from the seed's facts; $viewerName is the signed-in person; $brandTerms expands to the BANNED list in scripts/check-brand-refs.mjs and matches whole words only. A placeholder the seed did not provide is NOT MEASURABLE, and the walk exits 3.
Require text only the page's own body renders. The Layout header and footer carry the village name on every page, so a bare $villageName proves nothing about the page.
A surface with required: false that does not exist yet is reported as missing and does not fail the walk. A required one that is missing fails it.

expect.<role>.path: the pathname the page must end on after it settles (for a redirect). views: a button to press, by its accessible name, from the resting page; roles limits who is shown that button, and a view's own expect.<role> adds text and forbidden text for that role.
A request to /api/* answering 4xx fails the page unless allowRequests lists it (top level, surface, view or expect.<role>): regular expressions over "<status> <METHOD> <path>".

Wave 2 (2026-09-28): $conflictReplyTime and $outsideContactName come from the seed's conflict door; decision-matrix opens the canvas view from its address (?view=canvas) and presses the matrix button once.

Wave 3a public-lines (2026-09-28): /governance is "How we work together"; a visitor reads the public lines and the public matrix only, a member also the note that blocks open members' words, the founder the pen's controls; the seed's canvas reading ($canvasReading) must never render there.

roles.member: a member with no seat and no admin reach
roles.founder: founder 1, who holds the canvas pen before the handover
